import sys, zipfile, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
ns = {'w':'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main'}
with zipfile.ZipFile(sys.argv[1]) as z:
    root = ET.fromstring(z.read('word/document.xml'))
body = root.find('w:body', ns)
p_index = table_index = 0
for element in body:
    if element.tag == '{'+ns['w']+'}p':
        p_index += 1
        text = ''.join(element.itertext())
        style = element.find('w:pPr/w:pStyle', ns)
        print(f'P{p_index} [{style.get("{"+ns["w"]+"}val") if style is not None else "paragraph"}]: {text}')
    elif element.tag == '{'+ns['w']+'}tbl':
        table_index += 1
        for row_index, row in enumerate(element.findall('w:tr', ns), 1):
            cells = [' / '.join(''.join(p.itertext()) for p in cell.findall('w:p', ns)) for cell in row.findall('w:tc', ns)]
            print(f'T{table_index}:R{row_index}: ' + ' | '.join(cells))
print(f'COVERAGE: {p_index} top-level paragraphs, {table_index} tables; no rendering or OCR performed.')
PY
